projectsSection.title: Featured Projects
projectsSection.hubSubtitle: A complete collection of my academic work, professional projects, and freelance experiences.

bem-digital.title: Bem-Digital | NGO Hub
bem-digital.shortDescription: Donation campaign platform with inventory control and a modular permission system.
bem-digital.description: Bem-Digital is a complete platform for institutions to run donation campaigns. It features inventory control, public profiles for NGOs, donation tracking, and collection point management.
bem-digital.challenges: The project required structuring a complex relational database, using polymorphism for photos and a pivot table for a permission system based on Modules and Rules. Working in a 5-person team required strong technical alignment and Git workflow management.

fleet-manager.title: FleetManager | Fleet Management
fleet-manager.shortDescription: Vehicle entry and exit control system with dynamic dashboards per user profile.
fleet-manager.period: Developed for the Public Sector (City Hall).
fleet-manager.description: A robust internal system, nearly at an ERP level, developed for yard logistics control. It implements full management (CRUDs) with soft deletes, real-time yard operations, and unified global search.
fleet-manager.challenges: The application was 100% containerized using Docker and Laravel Sail to ensure environment parity. For UX, I implemented Dark/Light mode persistence, global font resizing control, and dynamic input masks.

chopits.title: Chopits | E-commerce
chopits.shortDescription: Functional virtual store clone focused on state management and routing.
chopits.description: A robust Front-end application developed to simulate the shopping experience of a large e-commerce, featuring a shopping cart, product listing, and real-time calculations.
chopits.challenges: The main focus was ensuring strict typing with TypeScript throughout the data flow, from product listing to (mocked) cart checkout, ensuring a bug-free runtime application.

tech-store.title: Corporate Website | TechStore
tech-store.shortDescription: Freelance project delivered to a computer hardware store with a modern, responsive design.
tech-store.description: Development of a complete corporate website with multiple pages (Home, Services, About, Contact) focused on attracting local clients and detailing the maintenance service portfolio.
tech-store.challenges: The challenge was working end-to-end: from gathering requirements with the client and designing the interface, to coding and optimizing for mobile devices.
